sections.title: Sequencing educational stages with postpositions
sections.content: You know the time postpositions *után* (after), *előtt* (before) and *közben* (during) from A1 (Unit 17). They follow the noun in the nominative and put the stages of school in order.

items.spanish: Az érettségi előtt a diákok sokat ismételnek.
items.english: Before the school-leaving exam, students revise a lot.

items.spanish: A gimnázium után egyetemre szeretnék menni.
items.english: After grammar school, I would like to go to university.
During the course, we learn a lot.
